observed_before.open_watchdog_incident_reason: the intentionally stopped coordinator remains unavailable

ordered_maximum_effect: apply only Alembic revision 028 with the existing production migration DSN; its transactional repair may close orphan leased jobs and attempts and backfill the runtime policy snapshot
update the stopped coordinator image on the same Machine ID and start it
after the coordinator gate passes, gracefully stop, image-update, and start the structure-range Machine on the same ID
after the structure gate passes, gracefully stop, image-update, and start the quote-batch Machine on the same ID
after all worker and observe-only gates pass, update the stopped qualification Machine image and only its POLYARB_QUALIFICATION_RELEASE_ID to the source release SHA, then start the same Machine ID
begin one new append-only 86400-second qualification epoch and independently reverify its immutable certificate
required_gates: database revision is exactly 027 before and exactly 028 after migration
all three worker Machines use the same immutable digest and retain their exact IDs and image-excluded configuration
the two running lanes are changed one at a time and only after bounded service-stop evidence or lease preservation is observed
the runtime controller remains observe-only with its empty recovery allowlist and zero recovery actions
Structure fetch/materialize/normalize/certify, Quote admit/batch/certify, and opportunity certify reach valid durable states without orphan running attempts or restart exhaustion
qualification successor identity starts at the live ingress high-water mark and only current-release evidence enters its accumulating window
forbidden_effects: no new, deleted, or replaced Fly app or Machine
no Machine ID, VM, region, volume, IP, service, restart policy, secret value, or hidden secret-set change
no image change outside the four exact targets
no runtime-controller update, restart, recovery allowlist expansion, recovery-mode change, or recovery action
no fault injection, wallet, signing, order, balance, or trade action
no raw provider response or secret value in evidence
rollback: a migration failure is contained by PostgreSQL transactional DDL and stops rollout before any Machine update
stop qualification immediately if its identity, first-tick, cursor, or evidence gate fails
restore changed Machines to the prior immutable image in reverse order if their process or durable-publication gate fails
retain additive revision 028 after any worker has executed it; do not destructively downgrade live runtime-v2 evidence
reverify exact topology, original Machine IDs, observe-only continuity, zero recovery actions, and append-only evidence
